jobs.description:
Experience Aviva

Together, we are Aviva.
Our values — Care, Commitment, Community, and Confidence — guide how we show up for each other and for our customers. Individually, they’re words. Together, they define who we are.

At Aviva Canada
, we put people first, our employees, our customers, and our communities. We’re proud of a culture built on care, inclusion, and collaboration, where your voice matters and your growth is supported. We’re not just about insurance; we’re about making a real difference by protecting what matters most.

The Opportunity

We're looking for an AVP, Data Science & Price Modelling
to lead a talented team that's transforming how we use analytics, machine learning, and predictive modelling to drive profitable growth and better outcomes for our customers.

In this role, you'll lead the development and delivery of advanced pricing models and data-driven solutions while partnering with teams across Pricing, Actuarial, Risk, and Technology. You'll combine technical leadership, business partnership, and people development to help shape decisions, solve complex challenges, and advance Aviva's data science capabilities. You'll have the opportunity to influence how one of Canada's leading insurers applies AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics to solve real business challenges at scale.

If you're passionate about building high-performing teams, turning data into action, and creating meaningful business impact, we'd love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of leaders, data scientists, and analysts, creating an environment where people can grow, collaborate, and do their best work.
Drive the development, enhancement, and deployment of advanced pricing models, machine learning solutions, and predictive analytics capabilities.
Partner with business leaders to identify opportunities where data science can improve customer outcomes, business performance, and operational effectiveness.
Translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations that influence business decisions.
Oversee model governance, validation, monitoring, and ongoing performance to ensure models remain effective, reliable, and aligned with business and regulatory requirements.
Champion innovation by exploring emerging technologies, analytical techniques, and industry best practices.
Work closely with Pricing, Actuarial, Risk, Technology, and Engineering teams to deliver scalable, data-driven solutions.
Drive adoption of analytical tools, models, and insights across the business to maximize value and measurable impact.
Help shape priorities, allocate resources, and deliver key initiatives that support business objectives.
Foster an inclusive and collaborative culture that encourages curiosity, continuous learning, and diverse perspectives.

What You’ll Bring

Undergraduate degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Actuarial Science, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
10+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field.
Proven experience leading and developing high-performing technical teams.
Experience delivering data science and analytics solutions that solve complex business challenges and create measurable value.
Strong understanding of predictive modelling techniques, machine learning methodologies, and model development practices.
Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and build trusted relationships across technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience developing, implementing, and managing analytical models and data-driven solutions.
Strong business acumen with the ability to connect analytical insights to business outcomes.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts in a clear and meaningful way.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities, with experience balancing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

What Makes You Stand Out

Deep understanding of pricing analytics, predictive modelling, and machine learning within a complex business environment.
Knowledge of the Property & Casualty insurance industry and the opportunities data science can unlock.
Success building high-performing teams and developing future leaders.
Ability to connect business strategy, analytics, and technology to deliver meaningful outcomes.
Advanced degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Actuarial Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.

What You’ll Get

Compelling rewards package including base compensation, eligibility for annual bonus, retirement savings, share plan, health benefits, personal wellness, and volunteer opportunities. 
Hybrid flexible work model.
Outstanding career development opportunities.
We’ll support your professional development education.
Competitive vacation package with the option to purchase 5 extra days off per year. 
Employee-driven programs focused on gender, LGBTQ+, origins, diversity, and inclusion. 
Corporate wellness programs to support our employees’ physical and mental health. 
Employee discount on home and auto insurance (where applicable).

jobs.description:
Job Description

What makes this role important at Ipsos?

As a Vice President, you will serve as a senior quantitative research leader and trusted advisor to clients. You will work with senior stakeholders to translate complex business challenges into clear learning agendas, testable hypotheses, and rigorous research methodologies that drive decision-making and business impact.

This role requires deep expertise in quantitative research design, advanced statistical techniques, and quantitative best practices. You must be comfortable thinking on your feet, providing methodological guidance in real time, and confidently defending analytical approaches with clients and colleagues. Beyond delivering insights, you will help shape the questions that matter, determine how they should be tested, and translate findings into strategic recommendations.

Our ideal candidate is an intellectually curious and commercially minded research leader who combines methodological excellence with strategic thinking, client advisory skills, and a passion for turning evidence into action.

This is a highly quantitative role. Candidates must possess significant hands-on experience designing, executing, and interpreting advanced quantitative research studies and analyses. Experience managing quantitative projects alone is not sufficient; successful candidates will have personally applied advanced analytical techniques and statistical methods throughout their careers. Individuals whose experience is primarily qualitative should not apply.

What You Can Expect To Be Doing

Lead the design of complex research and advisory engagements that address critical client business challenges and contribute to business growth.
Translate client issues and strategic questions into learning agendas, testable hypotheses, and robust research methodologies.
Apply advanced analytical techniques and methodological best practices to ensure research is insightful, innovative, and fit for purpose.
Serve as a senior advisor to clients, helping them interpret findings, evaluate strategic options, and make informed decisions.
Lead the development of reports, presentations, workshops, and executive-level recommendations that move beyond reporting results to driving action.
Collaborate across Ipsos service lines to bring the full breadth of Ipsos expertise to clients and identify opportunities for integrated solutions.
Contribute to business development activities, including proposal development, thought leadership, and identifying opportunities for growth within existing and prospective client relationships.
Build Ipsos' reputation internally and externally through subject matter expertise, innovation, thought leadership, and market presence.
Coach and mentor researchers at all levels on research design, analytical thinking, storytelling, strategic consulting, and client management.

Client Management Responsibilities

Acts as a senior trusted advisor to client leadership teams, providing strategic counsel on research, insight generation, and business decision-making.
Leads complex client conversations involving methodology, interpretation, business implications, and challenging or ambiguous situations.
Anticipates client needs and proactively recommends research and advisory solutions that address emerging opportunities and risks.
Builds and maintains senior-level relationships that contribute to long-term partnerships, business retention, and revenue growth.
Supports and coaches team members in managing client relationships and navigating difficult stakeholder situations.

Study Lead Responsibilities

Oversees the design and execution of complex research programs from hypothesis development through final recommendations.
Guides methodological decisions and analytical approaches, ensuring technical rigor and alignment with client objectives.
Leverages advanced quantitative techniques, segmentation, modeling, forecasting, and other analytical approaches, as appropriate.
Synthesizes findings across multiple data sources to identify patterns, implications, and strategic opportunities.
Leads development and delivery of executive-level reporting and presentations that connect research findings to business outcomes.

Employee Management Responsibilities

Manages and develops researchers and team leaders, providing ongoing coaching, mentorship, and performance development.
Builds team capabilities in research design, analytical methods, strategic thinking, consulting skills, and client advisory.
Creates an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, continuous learning, and methodological excellence.
Identifies and develops future leaders within the organization.

STRATEGIC THINKING EXPECTATIONS

Serves as a strategic leader for client accounts and research engagements.
Demonstrates hypothesis-driven thinking and the ability to connect business objectives with research solutions.
Quickly assesses complex situations, identifies key issues, and develops practical paths forward.
Balances methodological rigor, client realities, commercial considerations, and organizational priorities.
Anticipates emerging trends, risks, and opportunities and helps shape Ipsos' approach to addressing them.
Influences strategic direction for clients, projects, and the broader business through evidence-based recommendations and thought leadership.

This might be the job for you if you have:

8-10+ years of experience in market research, insights, consulting, or a related field.
Deep expertise in quantitative research methodologies and advanced analytical techniques.
Proven ability to transform complex business questions into actionable research programs and testable hypotheses.
Strong understanding of research best practices and the ability to select, defend, and communicate methodological approaches.
Exceptional critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think on your feet in high-stakes client situations.
Demonstrated success advising senior client stakeholders and leading complex engagements.
Strong storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to connect data to strategic business decisions.
Experience coaching and developing high-performing teams.
Strong commercial acumen and experience contributing to business development and account growth.
Bachelor's Degree required; Master's degree considered an asset.
Experience with advanced analytical platforms and statistical software such as SPSS, R, Python, or equivalent.

If you don’t meet 100% of the requirements, we encourage all who feel they might be a fit for the opportunity to apply. We may consider a variety of backgrounds for a particular role and are also committed to considering candidates for available positions throughout our organization, not just the one you’re applying to!

In accordance with NY/CO/CA/WA law, the estimated base salary range for this role is $105,000 CAD to $115,000 CAD. Your final base salary will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors which may include but are not limited to location, work experience, skills, knowledge, education and/or certifications.

What’s In It For You

At Ipsos you’ll experience opportunities for Career Development, an exceptional benefits package (including generous PTO, healthcare plans, wellness benefits), a flexible workplace policy, and a strong collaborative culture.

Benefits

To find out more about all the great reasons to work at Ipsos, how we’re making an impact around the world, and more about our benefits and employee programs, please visit:

Why Work at Ipsos | US

Commitment to Diversity

Ipsos recognizes the necessity of building an inclusive culture that values each employee’s individuality and diverse perspectives. For more than 40 years, our mission has been to generate and analyze data about society, markets, brands, and behaviors to provide our clients with the insights that elevate their understanding of the world. This could not be fulfilled without Ipsos’ diverse employees who compile and analyze this data—they are the essence of who we are and what we do.

We are committed to providing equal opportunity to all employees, creating an environment that promotes inclusion, and enabling employees from all walks of life to flourish. Ipsos encourages our employees to act in a respectful and responsible manner, in line with code of best practices concerning diversity and inclusion, human rights, equality, and civility for every individual.

Ipsos is An Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or any other protected class and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

About Us

Ipsos is one of the world’s largest research companies and currently the only one primarily managed by researchers, ranking as a #1 full-service research organization for four consecutive years. With over 75 different data-driven solutions, and presence in 90 markets, Ipsos brings together research, implementation, methodological, and subject-matter experts from around the world, combining thematic and technical experts to deliver top-quality research and insights. Simply speaking, we help the biggest companies solve some of their biggest problems, serving more than 5000 clients across the globe by providing research, data, and insights on their target markets. And we are proud of our continuous efforts in making Ipsos the best place to work!

About The Team

The Public Affairs Service Line is the world leader in Social and Opinion Research.We work with clients on political and public opinion polling, citizen and stakeholder management, social policy improvement, sustainable development strategy and identifying societal trends and perceptions across several sectors.We assess how government and public affairs policies as well as societal trends and views impact our client’s brand/products/markets.

jobs.description:
About Us

SickKids Foundation, with over 50 years of philanthropic impact is Canada's largest charitable funder of child health research, learning and care, raising over $200 million last year. As a national charity, SickKids Foundation invests in national and international initiatives to benefit children in Canada and around the world. As the fundraising partner to The Hospital for Sick Children (SickKids), we are aligned in supporting Precision Child Health (PCH), the future of tailoring medicine to each child's unique traits so SickKids can diagnose faster, treat smarter, and predict better.

We are driven by our core values of integrity, collaboration, excellence, innovation, and inclusion, with goals of delivering a superior donor experience, investing in our people and culture, driving innovative and sustainable fundraising, and disrupting the market through data and technology.

SickKids Foundation is committed to an inclusive culture by embedding equity, diversity and inclusion in our policies, practices, and behaviours. We aim to build awareness and skills in this area, both internally and with our partners. Our commitment extends to creating a safe, positive work environment. For details on our Equity, Diversity & Inclusion commitment, please click here.

We’re committed to attracting and retaining passionate individuals to help create a healthier future. That’s why SickKids Foundation is looking for a new Associate Director, Data Engineer.

Description Of The Position

Reporting to the Director, Data Science & Engineering, the Associate Director, Data Engineer designs, builds, and operates enterprise-grade data platforms that deliver trusted, well-governed data across SickKids Foundation. The role will help establish and evolve a production-grade cloud platform using medallion architecture principles, with a focus on reliability, data quality, cost efficiency, and scalable delivery.

As a senior hands-on technical contributor, you will set engineering standards, support platform incident response, enable self-serve analytics and AI-powered data products, and provide specialized technical guidance to data and analytics partners across the Foundation.

You will

Design, build, and operate enterprise-grade data engineering platforms using modern cloud technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks, aligned to bronze, silver, and gold medallion architecture principles.
Build and maintain robust, idempotent ETL/ELT pipelines with embedded validation, data quality checks, clear lineage, and repeatable delivery workflows.
Design data models and semantic layers that make trusted data accessible for analytics, reporting, and self-serve business intelligence.
Establish platform observability through query profiling, cost attribution, utilization metrics, alerting, and SLO/SLA monitoring; lead day-to-day response to data availability and performance incidents.
Define and enforce coding standards, CI/CD patterns, and Infrastructure-as-Code practices to support consistent, secure, and scalable platform deployment.
Partner with business stakeholders, Data & Analytics, IT/Infrastructure, and Security teams to translate requirements into reliable platform capabilities and support appropriate access, governance, and compliance.
Enable AI and advanced analytics use cases, including natural-language querying and AI-powered data products, by partnering with stakeholders to identify and deliver high-value opportunities.
Stay current with developments in cloud data platforms, AI, and emerging engineering practices, bringing relevant advancements into the platform roadmap and providing technical guidance to analysts, BI developers, and engineering partners.

Qualifications

While we know that for any job posting no one candidate will possess the qualifications being sought in equal measure, below is an outline of the qualifications we believe are important for a candidate to bring to the position or for the successful candidate to develop while in the role:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
5-7 years of hands-on data engineering or platform engineering experience, ideally spanning the full lifecycle of architecting, building, and operating production data platforms.
Deep technical expertise with modern cloud data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, or Databricks and strong knowledge of medallion/lakehouse architecture.
Strong data modelling and database design skills for analytics and business consumption, including dimensional modelling and semantic layers for self-serve BI.
Hands-on experience developing production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines and working with data quality, governance, CI/CD, and Infrastructure-as-Code practices.
Experience establishing observability, performance monitoring, reliability standards, and incident-response practices in production data environments.
Working knowledge of AI and advanced analytics tooling, including approaches that support natural-language querying and AI-powered data products.
Strong technical judgment, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholder groups.
Knowledge of foundational data domains, business processes, and enterprise applications is an asset.

We’re looking for a passionate individual who is interested in moving the dial and making a difference. We are an environment that looks to attract hardworking and committed people; people who want to challenge themselves and grow with a globally recognized brand that continues to change the world. If this describes you, consider joining our team. We look forward to reviewing your application.

Total Compensation Package

Expected Hiring Salary Range:
$99,297 - $124,121; with the ability to progress to a maximum of $142,739 with demonstrated experience and proficiency. To ensure fair and equitable pay at SickKids Foundation, placement on the salary range will be based on your years of experience, skills, and qualifications relevant to the Associate Director, Data Engineer role.

To help you lead in the fight for kids’ health and to support your health, wellness, and career growth, in addition to competitive compensation, we offer a comprehensive benefit package (includes a flex benefit plan), tuition reimbursement, flexible work arrangements, pension plan and birth parent/parental top up – to name a few!

How to apply
: Please apply on-line by visiting our website: https://www.sickkidsfoundation.com/careersandvolunteers

Please note that automated tools, including artificial intelligence, may be used to support the pre-screening of applications as part of our recruitment process.

SickKids Foundation is committed to its people and the talents, capabilities, and perspectives they bring to our mission. We live that commitment by being open and accessible to all, by valuing and respecting every individual, and by equally supporting every employee. As an organization proud to have joined the BlackNorth Initiative’s CEO pledge, we uphold our commitment by inviting and encouraging individuals from diverse lived experiences from Black, Indigenous, communities of colour, people with disabilities, 2SLGBTQIA+ community and all candidates who may contribute to the further diversification of the Foundation’s community.

North America Construction (1993) Ltd. – NAC Constructors Ltd. (NAC) is well known for our expertise in water and wastewater construction across Canada. Our self-performing team of almost 500 skilled professionals and experts in trades and engineering, comprehensively handles projects, from conceptualization to delivery. We also have extensive experience in fields such as civil, structural, process mechanical, building mechanical, electrical and instrumentation work. At NAC, our priority is to maintain the highest level of quality and safety. The depth of our resources is evident in the variety of projects we construct; from water filtration to wastewater treatment; dams to ethanol; we build it all….and more!

Bring your construction industry knowledge and technology leadership experience to NAC, where you’ll have the opportunity to shape our technology strategy, modernize business systems, and drive meaningful business transformation.

North America Construction (NAC) is looking for a business-minded technology leader who understands the demands of a construction or project-based environment and can translate technology into practical business improvements.

Reporting to the VP, Corporate Services, you will lead NAC’s technology strategy, manage a small internal technology team, and oversee external providers. Working closely with executive leadership and teams across finance, operations, estimating, HR, equipment, and projects, you will improve business systems, decision-making, productivity, and the employee experience.

Position Responsibilities:

Technology Strategy & Governance

Maintain a technology and transformation roadmap aligned with corporate priorities and business objectives.
Establish technology governance, standards, policies and decision-making processes.
Manage budgets and investment plans, assess emerging technologies, and develop and present business cases to executive leadership.

Enterprise Applications

Provide strategic direction for NAC’s enterprise applications, including ERP platforms, Jonas Construction Software, Procore, Primavera P6, Concur, HR systems, equipment and fleet systems, and future applications.
Lead or oversee enterprise system implementations, integrations, modernization and enhancements, including requirements definition, vendor management, implementation planning, change management and user adoption. Ensure systems are effectively integrated, aligned with business processes, and support operational efficiency and NAC's evolving business needs.

Data & Analytics

Lead data governance, stewardship, business intelligence and reporting capabilities, including Power BI, executive dashboards, consistent KPIs, and data warehouse and reporting architecture.
Ensure teams have access to reliable, timely and actionable information to support operational, financial and strategic decision-making.

Digital Workplace, Automation & AI

Lead digital workplace strategy, governance, and adoption across Microsoft 365, SharePoint Online, Teams, Power Platform, and Copilot.
Lead the planning, governance and adoption of AI and emerging technologies, including Microsoft Copilot, workflow automation, knowledge management and collaboration tools. Identify opportunities to improve productivity and business efficiency through effective implementation, change management and employee adoption.

Business Transformation & Process Improvement

Partner with business leaders to identify, prioritize and lead company-wide transformation initiatives and technology-enabled process improvements.
Lead initiatives to simplify workflows, reduce manual and administrative effort, and improve productivity and operational effectiveness. Work with business leaders to establish, measure, and evaluate the benefits and outcomes of these initiatives.

Technology Operations, Cybersecurity & Team Leadership

Provide strategic oversight of technology operations, infrastructure planning, managed service providers, service levels, cybersecurity, technology risk, business continuity and disaster recovery. Ensure technology services are secure, reliable and aligned with business needs and NAC's growth.
Lead and manage NAC's internal technology team, establishing priorities, delegating responsibilities, coaching and developing team members, and ensuring effective coordination with external service providers.
Ensure NAC has the appropriate resources, expertise, governance and controls to support its technology environment. Maintain overall accountability for technology performance, service delivery, operational reliability and risk management, whether delivered internally or through external providers.

Qualifications:

Post-secondary degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline preferred. Equivalent combinations of education and relevant experience will be considered.
Relevant professional certifications in project management, business analysis, IT service management, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture or organizational change management are considered assets.
10+ years of progressive experience in technology leadership, business systems, enterprise applications, digital transformation or business technology, with increasing responsibility for strategy, delivery and organizational outcomes.
Demonstrated experience leading technology functions, internal teams, external service providers and enterprise-wide initiatives.
Experience in construction, engineering, infrastructure, manufacturing or other project-based organizations strongly preferred.
Proven experience developing and executing enterprise technology strategies, roadmaps, governance frameworks and investment plans aligned with business objectives.
Demonstrated experience leading ERP implementations, enterprise application modernization, system integrations and business systems optimization.
Strong understanding of enterprise architecture, data management, business intelligence, analytics and executive reporting.
Experience leading enterprise business intelligence, data visualization and analytics platforms, such as Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, Domo or comparable solutions. Demonstrated ability to establish enterprise reporting frameworks, executive dashboards, consistent KPIs and data governance practices that support operational, financial and strategic decision-making.
Demonstrated success leading technology-enabled business transformation, process improvement and organizational change initiatives, with a focus on measurable business outcomes.
Experience overseeing IT operations, infrastructure, cybersecurity, technology risk management, business continuity and disaster recovery planning.
Familiarity with AI, automation, Microsoft Copilot and emerging technologies, including their practical business applications, governance considerations and organizational adoption.
Strong business acumen and financial awareness, with the ability to develop business cases, evaluate technology investments and assess their business value.
Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management and change leadership skills, including the ability to translate complex technology concepts into practical business recommendations and outcomes.

By the end of your first 24 months, you will have:

Established and implemented a clear enterprise technology and business transformation roadmap aligned with NAC's corporate priorities.
Strengthened technology governance, investment planning and executive decision-making, while building strong business-wide relationships.
Improved the effectiveness, integration and adoption of key enterprise applications and advanced the modernization of NAC's business systems.
Expanded adoption of Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power Platform and Copilot, supported by appropriate governance and employee adoption.
Strengthened company-wide reporting, analytics, data governance and executive visibility into business performance.
Identified and delivered meaningful improvements through automation, workflow redesign and technology-enabled process transformation.
Strengthened cybersecurity, technology risk management, business continuity, disaster recovery and overall operational reliability.

This executive leader drives coding accuracy, productivity, quality outcomes, regulatory compliance, audit readiness, and financial performance across professional, outpatient, inpatient, and specialty coding functions.

The VP develops and executes coding operations strategies that support organizational growth, revenue integrity, regulatory requirements, client satisfaction, and operational scalability. This role partners closely with Revenue Cycle Operations, Compliance, CDI, Revenue Integrity, IT, People Operations to deliver best in class coding services.

Develop and execute a long-term vision and strategic roadmap for coding, audit and compliance operations.
Establish operational goals, performance metrics, and service level standards aligned with organizational objectives.
Lead enterprise coding transformation initiatives, including automation, AI-assisted coding technologies, workflow optimization, and operational scaling.
Direct daily production coding operations across multiple specialties, service lines, and care settings.
Ensure achievement of productivity, quality, turnaround time, and client service commitments.
Oversee workforce planning, staffing models, scheduling, and capacity management for large remote and onshore/offshore coding teams.

Monitor industry updates and implement operational changes as necessary.
Analyze audit findings to identify trends, risks, education opportunities, and process improvements.
Drive performance improvement initiatives focused on reducing coding-related denials and compliance risks.
Ensure coding teams maintain accuracy rates consistent with organizational standards.
Lead, mentor, and develop directors, senior managers, managers, team leads, auditors, educators, and operational leaders.
Support recruitment, retention, and advancement of coding professionals.

Experience with multiple EHR and Encoder systems (CPSI, Meditech, Cerner, EPIC, 3M preferred).
High attention to detail, data accuracy and strategic thinking

Client-facing operational leadership experience.

Experience leading multi-site and remote and offshore workforce environments.
Demonstrated success overseeing compliance, quality, and audit programs.

Who are our customers, and how do their needs differ?

About The Role

Blacksmith Agency runs PPC and SEO for clients across multifamily, B2B and technical verticals. As Director of Performance Marketing you lead that department. The PPC strategist and the SEO strategist report to you and they are the specialists in their channels. Right now nobody owns this function, which is the whole reason this seat is open.

This is a management seat, not a senior individual contributor one.
You will not be building campaigns, and on technical SEO your strategist will know more than you do. That is the arrangement, not a gap. You carry channel strategy and where budget goes as accounts scale. The strategists carry the execution of it, and you carry whether the department delivers.

What You Own

The PPC strategist and the SEO strategist: their quality bar, their development, their reviews, and the call when someone is not going to get there.
The standard the work is held to. What a good audit looks like, what gets checked before work leaves the agency, how an account is reported. You write it and you hold two specialists to it.
Client results across the whole function, including whether our reporting is honest. Nobody here is auditing attribution and GA4 accuracy today.
The escalation when an account is at risk. You diagnose it, you direct the strategist who fixes it, and you are on the call with the client.
Channel strategy and where budget goes as accounts scale.
What we tell sales we can credibly deliver, before it gets sold.
The hiring plan for the department, and first-round interviews for your own team, within about a quarter.

What You Need

Strategists or specialists who have reported to you, where their reviews, their development and the decision when someone was not working out were yours. Managing accounts is not this.
7+ years across paid media and SEO. Owning one channel while sitting beside the other does not count here.
Enough depth in Google Ads, GA4, Search Console, Meta and Microsoft Ads to tell good work from work that merely looks good. That is a lower bar than doing it and a higher bar than reading a report.
One account you turned around that you can talk through: the metric, the figure before, the figure after, and why the change worked. Whose hands were on the keyboard matters far less than whether the diagnosis was yours.
Comfortable being the client-facing owner when an account is underperforming. That call comes to you, not to the strategist.
Agency experience carrying many accounts at once.

Please do not apply if

Nobody has ever reported to you, or you have never owned someone's review or had to performance-manage anyone.
You have only ever run one channel.
All of your experience is in-house on a single brand.
What you actually want is to keep building campaigns yourself. That is not a lesser ambition, it is a different job, and this is not it.

None of these are preferences we bend on. They are how we screen, so applying anyway costs you an hour and gets you a no.

Process

Three conversations, then a decision. A thirty minute screen with our recruiter, a first round with the founder this seat reports to, and a final. No take-home project and no panel interview.

uOttawa’s facilities encompass three main sites that are comprised of over 600,000 square meters of building space (over 6.4 million square feet), 42.5 hectares of grounds, 125 buildings and 4,500 beds in 11 residences. There are over 150 employees in Facilities, including Project Managers, Energy and Commissioning Specialists, Mechanical and Electrical Engineers, Architects, and space Planners. The facilities capital and operating expenditures are in the range of $100M for the University’s $2.0 billion assets under management. The 20-year Capital spending plan envisions $4.0 billion of new investment highlighted by uOttawa launch of project Top Shelf, a $300 million capital investment to build a new facility for the Faculty of Health Sciences at uOttawa’s River Campus, as well as a tower at the Roger Guidon campus to house uOttawa’s new Advanced Medical Research Center (AMRC).

Position purpose:

Reporting to the Associate Vice-President, Facilities, the incumbent provides strategic leadership, direction, and oversight of the University's facilities operations and maintenance activities to ensure the safe, reliable, efficient, and sustainable operation of its physical infrastructure in support of the University's teaching, research, and institutional objectives. Develops and implements strategies to drive operational excellence, organizational effectiveness, financial sustainability, and continuous improvement. Ensures the effective stewardship and lifecycle management of the University's physical assets through optimized resource utilization, risk-informed maintenance and infrastructure renewal strategies, while safeguarding operational resilience and business continuity.

In this role, your responsibilities will include:

Strategic Leadership and Operational Stewardship : Plans, directs, and oversees all aspects of the University's 24/7 facilities operations and maintenance programs, establishing strategic priorities, operational frameworks, and performance standards to ensure the effective stewardship of a physical asset portfolio valued at more than $3 billion. Ensures the delivery of safe, reliable, sustainable, and high-quality facilities services through effective governance, sound resource management, operational risk mitigation, and a commitment to institutional excellence and continuous improvement.
Operational Excellence and Service Delivery Optimization : Provides strategic leadership in the development, evaluation, and continuous optimization of facilities operations and maintenance service delivery models through performance benchmarking, reliability engineering, process improvement, resource optimization, and the implementation of industry best practices. Establishes comprehensive performance management frameworks, service standards, and key performance indicators to drive operational efficiency, accountability, service quality, and value for money, while ensuring alignment with the University's strategic and operational priorities.
Organizational Leadership, Workforce Effectiveness and Talent Development : Provides strategic leadership and direction to a diverse, multi-disciplinary, and multi-unionized workforce through the extended management team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. Ensures the effectiveness of organizational structures, workforce planning, succession management, leadership development, employee performance, and labour relations strategies to maintain a highly skilled, engaged, and adaptable workforce capable of meeting current and emerging institutional needs.
Critical Infrastructure Reliability and Continuity of Operations : Provides strategic oversight of the University's mission-critical infrastructure, building systems, central utility plants, and essential operational services to ensure their safe, reliable, efficient, and uninterrupted operation on a 24/7 basis. Establishes operational reliability standards, preventive and predictive maintenance strategies, system redundancy requirements, and contingency measures to minimize infrastructure failures, mitigate operational disruptions, and safeguard the continuity of teaching, research, and other essential University activities.
Regulatory Compliance, Occupational Health and Safety, and Operational Risk Management : Establishes and oversees comprehensive governance, risk management, and compliance frameworks to ensure facilities operations and maintenance activities meet applicable legislation, regulatory requirements, technical standards, and University policies. Provides strategic leadership in identifying, assessing, and mitigating operational, technical, environmental, and occupational health and safety risks, while fostering a proactive culture of regulatory compliance, workplace safety, and organizational accountability.
Financial Leadership and Resource Stewardship : Provides strategic leadership in the development, management, and optimization of the University's facilities operations and maintenance budgets, ensuring effective financial planning, resource allocation, expenditure control, and long-term financial sustainability. Establishes financial performance objectives and resource optimization strategies, evaluates operational investment opportunities, and ensures the efficient and responsible utilization of financial, human, and material resources in support of institutional priorities and service delivery requirements.
Emergency Preparedness, Infrastructure Resilience and Business Continuity : Provides strategic leadership in developing and implementing operational emergency preparedness, infrastructure resilience, and business continuity strategies to protect critical facilities and essential University services. Ensures the establishment, testing, and continuous improvement of emergency response procedures, infrastructure contingency plans, and operational recovery capabilities to minimize service disruptions and support the University's ability to respond effectively to emergencies, infrastructure failures, and other significant operational events.
Asset Lifecycle Management and Infrastructure Renewal : Provides strategic leadership in the assessment of infrastructure conditions, operational performance, asset reliability, and lifecycle maintenance requirements to support the sustainable management of the University's physical assets. Collaborates with institutional planning and capital investment stakeholders to identify, assess, and prioritize deferred maintenance, infrastructure renewal, and asset replacement requirements based on operational risk, asset criticality, lifecycle costs, and long-term institutional objectives.

Frame AI as a driver of customer outcomes, helping clients understand how AI can support measurable business goals such as increased revenue, improved conversion, lower operational costs, better customer experiences, and faster execution.

Improve visibility into account activity, pipeline, and next steps across Orium’s leadership team.
Build scalable playbooks, templates, and tools that improve consistency without adding unnecessary complexity.

Define and track success metrics such as increased opportunity conversion, improved forecast accuracy, and reduced manual effort.

Partner with cross-functional leadership to track bookings performance, forecast gaps, and account-level revenue opportunities.
